page.layout: One column of text under the title "ELENCHVS CAPITVM"; a table of contents with Roman-numbered chapter entries and page numbers at the right ends of the lines. Ends mid-entry at the foot with a hyphenated word.

main_text.head: ELENCHVS CAPITVM
main_text.l: Cap. I. Synodi coacta a Photio pro sui in thronum confirmatione, atq; restitutione recensentur. pag. 1
II. Roberti Creyghtoni de his ijsdem Synodis verba proferuntur, & numeratis mendacijs refelluntur. 9
III. Synodus Photiana ob multa in ea inconsiderate acta, dictaque, & praeter Synodorum dignitatem, falsitatis in suspicionem vocatur. 59
IV. Ex diuersitate textus, ex alijs, atque alijs Codicibus, & Photij astu, Synodum ementitam esse evincitur. 67
V. Hoc idem probatur ex Sacerdotio ipsius Photij, quod a Synodicis Θεοφι-[?] σον[?], a Deo decretum, nuncupa-tur. 73
VI. Ex scopo ac fine vnico Concilij, quae fuit restitutio Photij a depositis, & excommunicatis profecta, antequam accessisset assensus Pontificis Romani, hoc idem ostenditur. 96
VII. Ex corruptis a Photio Ioannis Octaui literis Apostolicis, & condemnata Octa-

page.notes: The Greek word at the end of Cap. V is partly unclear: the first part reads roughly "Θεοφι-" and the second "σον", but the joined word is not certain. The blue overlays are digitiser marks and were ignored. No page number is printed on this page. "Octa-" at the foot is a line break that continues onto the next page. The large initial S of Cap. I is joined to "Synodi".
